audit_items.title: Verify Fork Digest Computation: Is compute_fork_digest correctly implemented to derive the expected digest for each epoch?

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: ComputeForkDigest takes version and genesisValidatorsRoot as input, calls computeForkDataRoot to compute the fork data root, and returns the first 4 bytes as the fork digest.
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Implementation matches spec pseudocode: compute_fork_digest returns ForkDigest(compute_fork_data_root(current_version, genesis_validators_root)[:4])

phase2_analysis.validation_path: Fork version is derived from epoch via ForkDigestUsingConfig in config/params/fork.go:18-24. Genesis validators root is immutable once chain starts.
phase2_analysis.boundary_checks: Input validation relies on correct fork version being passed. The caching mechanism uses version+root as key.

formal_properties_verified: Determinism: Same inputs produce same output
Spec conformance: Output is first 4 bytes of fork data root hash
invariants_checked: Fork digest uniquely identifies fork version + genesis validators root combination
phase3_analysis.residual_risk: Low - Well-tested implementation with test vectors in signing_root_test.go:96-154

audit_items.audit_notes: Implementation correctly follows spec. Additional Fulu-specific fork digest modification in config/params/config.go:570-591 XORs blob parameters hash into fork digest for epochs >= FuluForkEpoch.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-005/tb-009: Is the proposer deterministically identifiable and cryptographically bound to each slot?

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: Proposer index computed deterministically from seed (derived from DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER + slot) and active validator indices using ComputeProposerIndex.
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Follows spec: seed = hash(get_seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER) + uint_to_bytes(state.slot)), return compute_proposer_index(state, indices, seed)

phase2_analysis.validation_path: Block proposer signature cryptographically binds proposer to block. Signature verification in block validation.

audit_items.audit_notes: Fulu introduces ProposerLookahead in state for efficiency (lines 310-326). Proposer selection is deterministic and cryptographically bound.

audit_items.title: Verify Proposer-Consensus Layer Interaction: Does the consensus layer correctly enforce proposer assignment from the lookahead?

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: For Fulu, uses state.ProposerLookahead() which stores pre-computed proposer indices. Validates slot is in current or next epoch.
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Proposer lookahead caching is implementation optimization consistent with spec semantics.

attack_vectors_analyzed: Proposer mismatch between lookahead and block validation
phase2_analysis.validation_path: Block validation verifies proposer signature matches expected proposer for slot.
phase2_analysis.boundary_checks: Proposer assignment enforced at block processing

audit_items.audit_notes: Implementation correctly uses cached lookahead for current/next epoch, falls back to computation for other epochs.

audit_items.title: Verify Validator Assignment Integrity: Can a validator deny or falsely claim proposer duty assignment?

phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Follows spec pseudocode exactly. Uses compute_shuffled_index for random selection.

phase2_analysis.validation_path: Selection is deterministic from randao + slot. Signature requirements prevent claiming another's proposal.

audit_items.audit_notes: Selection based on effective balance weighting. Historical assignments immutable once computed.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-009: Is the MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD delay sufficient to prevent same-epoch randao manipulation of proposer assignments?

phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Seed derivation uses get_seed(state, epoch, DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER) which incorporates MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD.

phase2_analysis.validation_path: MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD provides temporal separation between randao contribution and proposer assignment.

invariants_checked: Proposer selection uses past randao mix
phase3_analysis.residual_risk: Low - Attack requires significant validator share

audit_items.audit_notes: MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD provides adequate protection. Attack surface is theoretical with high stake requirements.

audit_items.title: Supporting Node Check: Verify validator randao contributions cannot be withheld or replayed to influence proposer selection

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: Randao reveal is part of block. Withholding means not proposing (slot missed). Replay protection via epoch binding.
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Randao reveal is BLS signature of epoch, bound to specific block slot.

phase2_analysis.validation_path: Missing randao = missed slot. Replayed randao would fail signature verification.

invariants_checked: Randao contribution cannot be withheld without missing slot

audit_items.audit_notes: Randao mechanism is well-established. Withholding only hurts the proposer (missed slot).

phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Spec: assert len(indices) > 0, then selects from indices only.

phase2_analysis.validation_path: activeIndices computed by ActiveValidatorIndices which filters by IsActiveValidatorUsingTrie.

audit_items.audit_notes: Implementation correctly validates against active set. ActiveValidatorIndices at line 99-149 properly filters by activation/exit epochs.

audit_items.title: Verify Consensus Layer Correctly Filters Exited Validators from Proposer Selection

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: IsActiveValidator: return validator.activation_epoch <= epoch < validator.exit_epoch. Exited validators have exit_epoch <= current_epoch.
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Matches spec: is_active_validator checks activation_epoch <= epoch < exit_epoch

attack_vectors_analyzed: Exited validator remaining in active set
phase2_analysis.validation_path: exit_epoch comparison ensures exited validators excluded.
phase2_analysis.boundary_checks: Epoch boundary correctly handled with < comparison

invariants_checked: Validators with exit_epoch <= epoch are excluded

audit_items.audit_notes: checkValidatorActiveStatus at line 56 correctly implements the active check. No off-by-one errors.

audit_items.title: Verify Slashed Validators Cannot Be Selected as Block Proposers

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: ComputeProposerIndex selects from activeIndices. The spec says slashed validators CAN be active (slashed flag separate from active status).
phase1_analysis.spec_alignment: Per spec, slashed validators remain active until exit_epoch. They CAN be selected as proposers but their blocks would be rejected.
identified_risks: Slashed validator producing block - rejected by honest nodes

phase2_analysis.validation_path: Block from slashed proposer would be rejected at block validation.
phase2_analysis.boundary_checks: Slashing does not immediately exclude from proposer selection

formal_properties_verified: Slashed validators can be selected but blocks rejected
invariants_checked: Block validation rejects slashed proposer blocks
phase3_analysis.residual_risk: Medium - Need to verify block validation rejects slashed proposer

audit_items.audit_notes: Per spec, slashed validators remain in active set until exit. Block validation should reject. Needs verification of rejection logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Not-Yet-Activated Validators Are Excluded from Proposer Selection

phase1_analysis.code_excerpt_summary: IsActiveValidator returns activation_epoch <= epoch. Validators with activation_epoch > epoch are excluded.

phase2_analysis.validation_path: activation_epoch > current_epoch means IsActiveValidator returns false.

audit_items.audit_notes: Implementation correctly excludes validators with activation_epoch > epoch.
